title: Cancel
description:
Cancelling a running query: `r`, a changed argument, `:DbDashStop` or `query.timeout`
stop it on the client and on the server. Needs `make it-up`. See `:help dbdash-cancel`.

query.sql: SELECT now()::time(0) AS started, clock_timestamp()::time(0) AS ended FROM pg_sleep({{ args.seconds }})

show.title: A slow query (press r while it runs)
show.description:
`pg_sleep({{ args.seconds }})` keeps the query busy on the server. Press `r` while it
runs: the query is cancelled (PostgreSQL CancelRequest) and a new one starts; the
previous result stays until then. Change `seconds` with `a`.

query.sql:
SELECT pid, state, date_trunc('second', now() - query_start)::text AS running, left(query, 40) AS query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = current_database() AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()

show.title: Other sessions (the sleep shows here while it runs)
show.description:
Every other session of the database (`pg_stat_activity`), refreshed every second: the
sleeping query shows here while it runs and disappears when it is cancelled.
